card.name: The number eight after Factor
card.fires_on: The numeral 8 or the word eight, mainly the Roman numeral VIII after the word Factor in clotting-factor text. It also fires on 'eight' in 'figure-eight' and on a digit in a radar model number.

modes.label: Factor VIII
modes.description: The Roman numeral VIII right after 'Factor' or 'factor' in coagulation and hemophilia text.

modes.label: Eight outside clotting text
modes.description: The number eight in non-medical names or terms, such as a figure-eight knot or a model number.
